release_scope: 1.5.1 user-first interaction preview, accurate example prompts and basic-match recovery; not an account-connected production release.

user_review.method: Builder-operated Chrome UI on desktop and390px viewport; actual helper regression tests; author-context source review. No independent human study.

scenarios.request: Open RedBot without a personal collection and decide what to do.
scenarios.expected: Explicit original examples, a simple goal, one supported result; no false account connection.
scenarios.observed: Chrome empty state required an explicit Try with example notes action. The goal Make my page less cluttered selected a guide with useful passage, sources and next action. Connection modal states account sync is unavailable.

scenarios.request: Save a suggestion and return later; recover when another suggestion is unavailable.
scenarios.expected: Plan survives reload; evidence stays available; no-match offers a useful reset.
scenarios.observed: Save for later, reload and Continue preserved the chosen goal/guide. Try another produced a clear no-match state with reset/change words. For now returned to the goal field after a coffee example.

scenarios.request: Find a saved coffee note on a phone-sized screen.
scenarios.expected: Readable main action, no horizontal overflow, searchable saves and reachable detail.
scenarios.observed: 390x844 Chrome viewport measured390 document width. My saves, drawer open/close, search iced coffee and note details worked. The natural-language coffee sample selected the matching original note and DayCup source. Physical phone performance untested.

scenarios.request: An assistant reads a chosen backup, including title-only, removed and malformed material.
scenarios.expected: Preserve input; expose exact source; unread stays unread and bad input fails.
scenarios.observed: 3 bundled reader tests passed against temporary backups. Existing read-only helper and retrieval instructions remain unchanged; renamed the web control to Save for later and made public account limitations explicit.

scenarios.request: Public account connection with no service, or private source text containing instructions.
scenarios.expected: Do not borrow owner login, invent complete scans or follow instructions embedded in notes.
scenarios.observed: Source walkthrough preserves read-only helper scope, untrusted-evidence rule, missing-input recovery and explicit local-only boundary. Public Connection UI offers only truthful preview information and examples. No public account acceptance claim.

scenarios.request: An earlier two-example library is asked for an iced-coffee note.
scenarios.expected: Do not suggest an absent example or use generic note wording to recommend design content.
scenarios.observed: Live returning-browser check reproduced an irrelevant design result. Fixed generic-term filtering, English word boundaries, current-save example prompts and versioned scripts.18 JS tests pass; actual local Chrome now returns no match for absent matcha and the correct original coffee note when present. Public patch verification follows deployment separately.

similar_skills.learned: Search returns leads; inspect full selected evidence before answering, and distinguish lexical from conceptual search.
similar_skills.reason: Use a bounded read-only shortlist plus exact-item retrieval; keep host reasoning separate from browser embeddings and do not require a separate indexing service. Reused for the 1.5 companion follow-up: shortlist/full-item retrieval and the helper remain unchanged; rechecked instructions still require source inspection and distinguish unavailable account sync.

similar_skills.learned: Progressive retrieval avoids loading complete raw history for every request.
similar_skills.reason: Shortlist IDs then fetch one exact source. Do not inherit the unrelated runtime, timeline schema or unverified token-saving claims. Reused for the 1.5 companion follow-up: shortlist/full-item retrieval and the helper remain unchanged; rechecked instructions still require source inspection and distinguish unavailable account sync.

validation.observed: 18 tests passed after the matching repair; actual missing-subject, substring false-positive and existing-coffee cases covered.
3 local connector tests passed; existing research, plans and absent saves retained; sign-in negation handled.
3 tests passed with temporary backups and preserved bytes.
VERDICT PASS after required Install and Why section names aligned; no check bypass.

known_limits: Public per-user Xiaohongshu authorization, full enumeration, account isolation and same-phone login are not implemented. This blocks the source-connected beta, not this explicitly labeled interaction preview.
Physical phone/assistive-technology and unaided new-user trials not completed.
Existing owner Mac app packaging was not updated by this release; local connector fixes are in application source.
